reason: Global context is allowed, but the directly opened UNEP Ozone Secretariat feature dated 2025-06-25 gives “99 per cent of production” phased out without an underlying dataset/report, defined production denominator, or observation year. The same Secretariat facts page says 99% of ODS phaseout but also lacks a reference year. Neither supports a time-bounded, methodologically documented percentage of tracked ODS phased out for the portrait. No city/county compliance percentage is published.
nearest_data: UNEP Ozone Secretariat feature, https://ozone.unep.org/refrigeration-cool-technology-heating-planet?q=node%2F16288, dated 2025-06-25, directly opened: states 99% of ODS production has been phased out. The article does not cite an underlying report/dataset or specify the measurement year/denominator; interpreted as dated publication context only, not as a compliant indicator value. The facts page https://ozone.unep.org/facts-and-figures-ozone-protection gives a broader global 99% ODS phaseout share but no reference year.
